caption: An avant-garde art-rock piece driven by antiphonal choirs, group stomps, and physical mouth percussion. Grounded in the obsessive declaration I love my kitty cats so much!, the song layers ejective attacks, glottal stops, and nasal resonance over a 3:2 coupled stomp substrate. Antiphonal counterpoint and breath hockets create a relentless, kinetic dialogue while budget ghouls and gaze freezers manage structural constraints under extreme performance commitment and sound exploration.
